{"diagnosis":"raw_transactions has 4996 rows but only 4975 distinct txn_id values (the ids are contiguous), so some transactions were delivered more than once across batches. silver_transactions has no dedup, so 17 duplicated POSTED ids show up twice and inflate every gold table. I have not seen the duplicate rows themselves, so the keep-latest rule below is an assumption.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM raw_transactions
) r
WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
